title: Foods Your Heart Loves
description: Simple foods that keep your heart strong. #hearthealth #nutrition #wellness

scenes.text: Your heart beats 100,000 times a day. Feed it well.
Fatty fish like salmon protect your arteries with omega threes.
Berries fight the inflammation that damages your heart.
Leafy greens lower your blood pressure naturally.
A handful of nuts a day keeps cholesterol in check.
Love your heart, and it will beat strong for life.
